claims: 2026 is a common year starting on Thursday.
FIFA World Cup 2026 is hosted by the USA, Canada, and Mexico in June-July.
FIFA World Cup 2026 features 48 teams in 104 matches.
July 4th marks the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence.
Artemis II is scheduled for April 2026.
Artemis II is intended as the first crewed deep-space mission since 1972.
The Winter Olympics and Paralympics are set for Italy.
U.S. midterm elections are scheduled for November.
For tax year 2026, standard deductions are set to rise to $32,200 for married couples filing jointly.
For tax year 2026, standard deductions are set to rise to $16,100 for single taxpayers.
The Lunar New Year begins on February 17, 2026.
The Lunar New Year in 2026 marks the year of the Fire Horse.
A total lunar eclipse (full blood moon) is expected on March 2nd
